title: NOMADWorkflowOutputsResourceAttributes

workflow_type.title: Workflow Type
workflow_type.description:
Type of computational workflow that generated these outputs.

- **Type**: string.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: REQUIRED in implementations.
  - **Query**: MUST be a queryable property with support for all mandatory filter features.
- **Examples**:
  - `"GeometryOptimization"`
  - `"MolecularDynamics"`
  - `"Elastic"`
  - `"Phonon"`
  - `"DFTGWWorkflow"`

final_outputs.title: Final Outputs Reference
final_outputs.description:
Reference to the final Outputs section containing computed physical properties.

- **Type**: string (reference ID).
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: SHOULD be supported by all implementations.
  - **Query**: MUST be queryable for linking to property results.
- **Examples**:
  - `"outputs_001"`
  - `"final_calculation_results"`

dos.title: Electronic Density of States
dos.description:
Reference to ElectronicDensityOfStates for electronic structure workflows.

- **Type**: string (reference to ElectronicDensityOfStates).
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: SHOULD be supported for electronic structure workflows.
  - **Query**: SHOULD be queryable for DOS-based filtering.

n_values.title: Number of Values

- **Type**: integer.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:

temperature.title: Temperature Values
temperature.description:

- **Requirements/Conventions**:

pressure.title: Pressure Values

- **Requirements/Conventions**:

description:
NOMAD workflow output results resource attributes following OPTIMADE specification. Contains computed properties from various types of simulation workflows including structural, electronic, thermodynamic, and spectroscopic calculations.

## Workflow Categories
- **Structural Workflows**: Geometry optimization, elastic properties, equation of state
- **Electronic Workflows**: Electronic structure, Beyond-DFT methods (GW, DMFT, TB)
- **Dynamic Workflows**: Molecular dynamics, phonon calculations
- **Spectroscopic Workflows**: Photon polarization, X-ray spectroscopy
- **Thermodynamic Workflows**: Temperature, pressure, and volume relationships

## Key Features
- **Multi-scale Results**: From atomic forces to bulk mechanical properties
- **Method Chaining**: Beyond-DFT workflows combine multiple electronic structure methods
- **Trajectory Data**: Time/step-dependent properties for optimization and dynamics
- **Convergence Metrics**: Flags and thresholds for computational convergence
- **Material Properties**: Elastic constants, bulk/shear moduli, mechanical stability

## Implementation Notes
- Workflow type is required for proper result interpretation
- Different workflows populate different subsets of properties
- Elastic workflows provide comprehensive mechanical property analysis
- Phonon workflows include stability analysis via imaginary frequencies
- Beyond-DFT workflows reference multiple electronic structure results
- Units follow SI conventions with OPTIMADE unit extensions
- Arrays support multi-dimensional scientific data (tensors, trajectories, spectra)
